summary: Ryan Wood Moss, 24, of Colorado Springs, reported overdue from a permitted Warner Route hike; body found June 13 at the base of a 500-foot cliff just off the route and recovered June 14 by helicopter; apparent fall
location: Warner Route, Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: National Park Service rangers; Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control helicopter
notes: Wilderness permit showed a planned return to his South Rim car on Saturday, June 11; family alerted the park Saturday afternoon. Cellphone pings aided the Monday helicopter search that located the body. NPS told the Montrose Press it appeared he fell; autopsy was pending at the time of the report. Merged the opened KVNF 2016-06-16 regional newscast headline page (Warner Route body-recovery headline source). | CPR autopsy follow-up: autopsy indicated significant alcohol (BAC 0.211) and marijuana intoxication contributed to the accidental fall.
